Turkish drone attack | Civilian dies affected by wounds in Tel Refaat

Aleppo province: SOHR activists have documented the death of a civilian affected by the wounds he sustained two days ago, in an attack by a Turkish drone on Tel Refaat in Kurdish and regime areas in northern Aleppo countryside.

Accordingly, the number of people who were killed in the Turkish drone attack has risen to four.

The Turkish drone strike also left seven people injured, some seriously; the death toll is believed to rise.

On August 24, SOHR activists reported that the number of people who were killed in a Turkish drone attack that hit a market in Tel Rifaat city centre had risen to three, including a woman from Afrin.

According to SOHR sources, the woman died of her severe wounds in Afrin hospital.

SOHR activists documented the death of two civilians and the injury of nine others in a Turkish drone attack that hit Tel Rifaat market in Aleppo countryside, where regime’s military security headquarters is located near the targeted site.

SOHR activists reported that a drone, believed to be a Turkish one, targeted Tel Rifaat city centre, leaving a number of people injured.

The victims were taken to Tel Rifaat hospital.

It is worth noting that this was the ninth attack of its kind in areas where Kurdish and regime forces are deployed in rural Aleppo since early July.
